desc: This Frigidaire 1.8 Cu. Ft. Over-The-Range Microwave makes meal time easier with Convenient Quick Start cooking options that help you put delicious meals on the table in minutes. Plus, changing your filter has never been more convenient with our Push to Open PureAir Filter Door and filter indicator light.
hl: Get meals on the table in minutes with three different Quick Start options that allow you to make yummy meals, faster.
Enjoy peace of mind and fresher air while cooking with the Frigidaire PureAir® Microwave Filter, which captures odors and helps recirculate air from the exhaust fan.
Changing your filter is now more convenient, simply press the door on the top interior panel to swap out your Frigidaire PureAir® Filter.
Offers a clear, bright view of your cooktop with bright LED lighting.
Keep your microwave running smoothly with the indicator light that reminds you when it's time to change your filter.
Over-the-range microwave doubles as a hood offering ventilation with two fan speeds.
